brief: The canvas displays colossal, impossible architectural forms, now rendered as hyper-faceted crystalline shards. These structures are perpetually subject to immense shearing forces, causing the planar surfaces to warp, curl, and fold dramatically. Cool, fractured light reflects off the jagged, iridescent edges, mapping structural tension through visible stress fractures that propagate across the crystalline faces. While these geometries slowly and constantly readjust in a state of suspended collapse, clicking anywhere on the canvas triggers a sharp, visible energetic ripple that momentarily intensifies the warping and shifts the entire composition.

statement: This sketch transforms the concept of structural stress into a woven tapestry of silk threads, rendered in the style of a 1960s pen plotter drawing. Instead of crystalline shards under shearing forces, we see delicate threads interlacing in an eternal dance of tension and release. The warp and weft threads move subtly, creating visual stress fractures where they intersect, while the entire composition gently oscillates between states of ordered weave and chaotic disruption. Clicking anywhere triggers a ripple effect that momentarily intensifies this weaving, shifting all threads into a momentary state of heightened tension before returning to their gentle, continuous motion. The work captures the microscopic beauty of structural integrity through the elegant simplicity of interlocking thread patterns.
